what: The Speed Distance Time Calculator solves the classic triangle: give it any two of speed, distance and time and it finds the third. Distances can be in kilometers, meters, miles, feet, yards or nautical miles, and speed in km/h, mph, m/s, ft/s, knots or running pace per km or mile.
Under the answer, tables convert the speed and distance into every unit and show the time in hours, minutes and h:min:s.
uses: Estimate driving or cycling time for a route.
Turn a race time into pace, or a target pace into a finish time.
Check speed, distance and time answers.
Work in knots and nautical miles.
Convert km/h to mph or m/s quickly.
tutorial: Pick Speed, Distance or Time. The box for that value is hidden.
Type the distance and choose its unit (unless you are finding it).
Fill in hours, minutes and seconds. Empty boxes count as 0.
Type the speed and pick its unit. For pace, type minutes per km or mile, like 5.5 for 5:30.
The answer appears in large text with the formula used.
See the speed in every unit, the distance in every unit and the time three ways.
features: km/h, mph, m/s, ft/s, knots and min per km or mile.
Times over a day show days too.
The formula used is written under the answer.
Warns if the speed is faster than light.

example.title: Worked example: a marathon pace
example.text: Choose Time, type 42.195 km and a pace of 5 min per km. The time is 3 h 30 min 59 s. Choose Speed instead with 10 km in 50 minutes and the answer is 12 km/h, which is a pace of 5:00 per km or about 7.46 mph.

tips: For average speed over a whole trip, include stops in the time.
Pace and speed are opposites: a lower pace is faster.
Use the Time Calculator to add up several legs first.
problems: It says time must be more than 0
Enter at least one of hours, minutes or seconds.
Check the units, for example meters vs kilometers.
Type pace as decimal minutes: 5:30 is 5.5.
